title: Boundary rectifiability BR_P(d) from the closure theorem CL_P(d), d + 1 < P (Simon 6.6.2–6.3, parent Part IV)
statement: Assume (MR), (IMC), (VO) (types of the accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub, dtc_vanish_off_support) and (DTr) (the in-range deformation theorem, verbatim the first conjunct of sibling deformation). Let P, d ∈ ℕ with d + 1 < P and assume CL_P(d): for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T_j, T ∈ 𝒟_d(U), if every T_j is IM, sup_j(M_W(T_j) + boundaryMassOn(T_j, W)) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U (boundary term M_W(∂T_j), or 0 in degree 0) and T_j ⇀ T, then T is IM. Then BR_P(d): for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and IM R ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(U) with M_W(∂R) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, ∂R is IM. Notation: SimonGMT currents, M_W = massOn W, ⇀ = WeaklyConvergesOn, IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity.
